reason: The frozen ZIP central-directory request sent a suffix Range request, but SeagrassNet returned HTTP 200. The runner read its capped 65,558-byte buffer before checking the HTTP status, so a prefix of the biological ZIP response was physically opened. No ZIP member was decompressed or parsed and no biological response value was interpreted.
integrity_boundary: Because raw biological archive bytes were opened, the same frozen USA+Canada SeagrassNet candidate universe must not be retried, repaired, or relabeled as an untouched external validation.
interpretation: This is a transport/protocol failure, not evidence for or against the Tampa quantitative early-warning hypothesis.
next_rule: Independent confirmation must use a genuinely different response-unopened dataset or a future prospectively held-out Tampa survey.
